# Skeleton
Animated bones held together by little more than spite. Rarely seen outside of spooky events.
## Benefits
- Resistant to slashing (20%), piercing (40%), cold, poison, radiation, asphyxiation, blood loss and cellular damage. - Blunt damage is reduced by a flat 5.
## Drawbacks
- Fragile: 100 critical / 150 dead, and they turn to dust at 150 damage. - Slowed down as they take damage.
